Posts.RecruitPostName: 3D动作策略游戏《虚环》-游戏高级交互设计师
Posts.Responsibility:
1.负责游戏项目的整体交互体验设计，覆盖系统框架、核心玩法界面、局内 HUD、成长养成、商业化和社交系统等模块，输出信息架构、交互流程、线框原型和交互说明文档；
2.深入理解游戏玩法和目标玩家群体，积极参与策划需求评审，从用户体验角度提出合理设计方案与优化建议，平衡玩法体验、商业目标和开发成本；
3.建立并维护项目交互设计规范和组件库，保障各系统体验一致性，推动规范在 UI 视觉设计和客户端开发环节有效落地；
4.负责移动端、PC、主机等多平台操作适配设计，涵盖触屏手势、键鼠、手柄的操作逻辑规划与焦点导航设计；
5.与策划、UI 视觉、动效、客户端程序、技术美术紧密协作，跟进设计在 Unity 或 Unreal 引擎中的实现效果，执行体验走查和验收工作；
6.结合用户研究、数据分析（如埋点、漏斗、A/B 测试）和玩家反馈，持续迭代版本体验，以数据量化设计效果并推动优化。

Business Unit
The Weixin Group (WXG) is dedicated to building one of the world’s most influential smart-life ecosystems via our interoperable services WeChat (for non-Chinese mainland users) and Weixin (for Chinese mainland users). Combined, they have more than 1.4 billion monthly active users (MAU) worldwide who are able to connect and communicate with one another.
From messaging and voice/video calls to Official Accounts, Weixin Pay, Mini Programs, WeCom, Weixin Search, Mini Games, Channels, and Mini Shops, we build the infrastructure that connects people, services, and businesses.
Weixin Pay has become a leading mobile wallet in China and beyond, powering everyday scenarios from dining and shopping to transportation, travel, and education.
Our cross-border payment network already spans 78 countries and regions, supporting settlements in 36 currencies, enabling global merchants to connect with the China market.
We are expanding our teams worldwide. Join us to redefine how people communicate, interact and transact on mobile — and shape the future of the global mobile ecosystem.

What the Role Entails
Analyze large datasets to identify business opportunities and optimize product performance.
Develop data dashboards and visualization tools to track key performance metrics and provide actionable product insights.
Assist in building scalable data pipelines to support WeChat’s operational needs and enhance platform security.
Support high-impact machine learning and multimodal AI initiatives that strengthen WeChat's core product experience.
Contribute to risk modeling and safety strategies that safeguard users and protect WeChat's platform integrity.

Who We Look For
Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
Proficiency in SQL and Python (knowledge of C/C++/Go is a plus).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen eye for detail.
Strong sense of ownership, customer-oriented mindset, and integrity.
Fast learner and effective team player with excellent communication skills.
Prior internship or work experience in the tech or internet industry is preferred.
Fluency in Chinese and English is valued in order to communicate with various stakeholders in headquarters over the globe.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Singapore-CapitaSky

What the Role Entails
About WeChat
With over 1.3 billion users worldwide, WeChat is shaping the future of digital communication by connecting people, services, and businesses across the globe. The WeChat operations team offers a unique opportunity to redefine how users engage with mobile technology while gaining valuable insights into global user behavior and preferences. Based in Singapore, our team is responsible for managing and expanding WeChat’s core product offerings, including messaging and social networking, for users outside the Chinese mainland. Join us in making a meaningful impact by keeping millions of people connected through one of the world's most influential digital platforms.
About the Internship
WeChat’s internships provide paid, full-time opportunities lasting a minimum of 12 weeks. Interns will be mentored by senior members of the WeChat operations team and work hands-on in developing new projects and product features. By the end of the internship, participants will have gained a deep understanding of WeChat’s values, independently executed data-driven projects, and collaborated effectively across multiple departments, including product, engineering, and legal teams.

Why Join Us?
Gain hands-on experience with large-scale data in a leading global tech company
Work with cutting-edge technologies and experienced mentors in a dynamic environment
Be part of an impact-driven team that shapes digital communication worldwide
Responsibilities
Analyze large-scale datasets to identify business opportunities, detect patterns, and optimize product performance across the platform.
Develop data dashboards and visualization tools to track key performance metrics and provide actionable product insights.
Design and build scalable data pipelines to support analytics, operational decision-making, and platform security initiatives.
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders (product, engineering, operations, and security teams) to translate analytical findings into business strategies and product improvements.
Leverage AI-powered tools and technologies (e.g., LLMs, AI copilots, data assistants) to enhance analysis efficiency, automate workflows, and improve decision accuracy while maintaining robust traditional data engineering and analytics practices.
Explore and integrate AI-driven methodologies to optimize analytical processes, including automated data exploration, report generation, and intelligent insight discovery.

Who We Look For
Requirements
Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
Strong experience in data analytics and data engineering, including building data pipelines, statistical analysis, and data visualization.
Proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience working with large-scale data platforms (e.g., Hive, Spark, or similar big data environments).
Experience building data dashboards and reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Superset, or similar platforms).
Familiarity with AI-assisted data analysis tools, including prompt engineering, context engineering, and AI workflow integration.
Experience with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), AI agents, MCP frameworks, or similar AI infrastructure is a strong plus.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to break down complex problems into structured analytical approaches.
Excellent learning ability, curiosity for new technologies, and a strong sense of ownership and self-driven execution.

Posts.RecruitPostName: 腾讯云-智慧零售交付项目经理-上海/深圳
Posts.Responsibility:
1.根据智慧零售项目交付和服务特点，制定相关项目管理流程包括项目启动、规划、执行、监控、关闭等各个阶段的流程和标准)，支撑交付团队业务执行，保障交付项目管理的标准化和一致性；
2.沉淀项目管理方法论，包括项目管理的理论、方法和工具等，支撑交付团队提高项目管理的效率和质量；
3.零售重大项目复盘及经营数据分析，保障重大项目损益偏差，并通过项目分析优化相关流程及规范，同时提供相关业务建议；
4.持续提升项目过程质量、配合组织项目管理要求，监督并推动交付项目过程改进，并持续改进和优化；
5.跟踪 AI 及大模型在零售场景的应用趋势，推动 AI 能力在交付项目中落地，并探索 AI 工具在项目管理中的提效应用。

Posts.RecruitPostName: 《三角洲行动》-高级商业化策划（海外）
Posts.Responsibility:
1.核心商业化资源全流程管线跟进：负责游戏内角色、武器、皮肤等核心商业化资源从概念设计、制作到最终上线的全流程管线推进，把控品质、进度与商业价值的平衡；
2.商业化系统与功能设计：负责游戏内商业化相关系统与功能（如商城、通行证/战令、抽取、礼包、活动付费等）的设计与开发跟进，保障系统体验流畅、付费转化健康；
3.售卖策略协同：与海外运营、发行团队紧密协作，结合各区域市场特性共同确定售卖策略、售卖方式与投放节奏，实现节奏化、精细化的商业化排期；
4.数据驱动迭代：基于付费、留存、活跃等数据反馈，灵活调整商业化规划、设计与生产节奏，持续优化 ARPU、付费率等核心指标；
5.PVP 商业化探索：深度挖掘 PVP 射击玩法的商业化维度，在保证竞技公平性的前提下，探索契合海外玩家的创新商业化形式，拓展营收增长点。

Posts.RecruitPostName: 《金铲铲之战》-视觉设计师-品牌宣发方向
Posts.Responsibility:
1.核心视觉与美术方向定调： 负责《金铲铲之战》《英雄联盟》等核心产品市场宣发原画、核心宣传画（Key Visual）的前期创意策划，主导并制定整体美术方向（Art Direction）；
2.品质与商业化把控： 负责发行业务线插画/原画类供应商的监修与指导。需从“产品主人翁”视角建立明确的视觉验收标准，带领并赋能外部团队，把控从概念草图到最终高精度成品的每一处细节，确保美术资产完美服务于产品商业化目标；
3.商业推演与跨界协同： 对接内部品牌、产品团队及 Riot 总部反馈。作为沟通与创作枢纽，能将各方较抽象的商业诉求或IP反馈，严谨推导并转化为明确、高水准的视觉解决方案。

Posts.ProductName: 生态赋能-其他(IEG)-轻游戏合集
Posts.Responsibility:
1.ai agent游戏平台核心体验设计：负责craft整体交互架构与流程设计，通过系统化设计降低操作复杂度，提升易学性与易用性；
2.小游戏模板交互：负责craft中官方小游戏模板的交互设计。熟悉热门小游戏玩法与交互流程，能够快速产出规范统一、流程清晰的各类小游戏交互方案；
3.用户研究与数据驱动：深入理解创作者与普通玩家的行为模式与核心痛点，通过用户调研、数据分析等方法定位编辑器的使用瓶颈与流失点，持续驱动产品体验与创作效率的提升；
4.交互文档与原型输出：输出高质量的交互原型，编写清晰的交互说明文档，并协同UI、程序、策划团队，确保设计方案的高质量落地；
5.建立与维护设计系统：主导建立并持续维护设计组件库与规范，确保设计语言的一致性，提升团队协作与开发效率；
6.跨部门协作：紧密对接策划，将功能需求转化为合理的界面逻辑；协同技术美术与开发团队，评估实现可行性。
